name: debark-gui
//: This project has zero npm dependencies and no JavaScript build step.
The three frontend keys below are what enforces that, and each is set to
a non-default value on purpose:
frontend:install is empty, so Wails runs no package manager at all.
There is no frontend/package.json for it to install from.
frontend:build is the copy step: frontend/index.html, frontend/src and
frontend/wailsjs are copied verbatim into frontend/dist, which
main.go embeds. Wails runs this command with the working directory
set to frontend/, which is why the path is '../hack/copyfrontend';
the command itself finds the project root either way, so 'make
frontend' runs the same tool from the repository root. Wails splits
this string on spaces and execs it - there is no shell, so no
pipes, redirects or quoting.
frontend:dev:serverUrl is empty, so 'wails dev' serves the app from
its own AssetServer instead of waiting for an external dev server.
The default ('auto') makes Wails probe for a Vite server that will
never appear and then time out.
assetdir points 'wails dev' at frontend/dist on disk rather than the
embedded copy, so re-running 'make frontend' refreshes a running dev
session without a rebuild. There is no watcher: nothing here compiles,
so a watcher would only be re-running a file copy on every keystroke.
This '//' key and $schema are ignored on load, but 'wails dev -save'
rewrites this file from its own struct and would delete both. Do not
pass -save; change settings here by hand.
